applied.quote: Acorns adds Round-Ups and IRA matches on its Silver and Gold plans.
applied.replacement: Acorns adds Round-Ups on every plan and IRA matches on its Silver and Gold plans.
applied.why: Round-Ups are in Bronze; only IRA matches are Silver/Gold.

applied.quote: Withdrawals to a linked checking account carry no fee, so selling and withdrawing avoids that $75 charge on an account you plan to close.
applied.replacement: Withdrawals to a linked checking account carry no fee.
applied.why: SOURCE does not say withdrawing avoids the transfer fee.

applied.quote: M1 fits investors who want to choose their own stocks and ETFs with automation and no management fee.
applied.replacement: M1 fits investors who want self-directed investing with automation and no management fee.
applied.why: SOURCE does not say M1 trades stocks and ETFs.

applied.quote: The other six alternatives build the portfolio.
applied.why: SOURCE does not say every other alternative builds the portfolio.

applied.quote: Fidelity Go fits investors under $25,000 who want no advisory fee, and investors above that line who want coaching sessions included in the 0.35% fee.
applied.replacement: Fidelity Go fits investors under $25,000 who want no advisory fee, and investors above that line who want coaching sessions.
applied.why: SOURCE does not say coaching is included in the 0.35% fee.
